name: 哈尔滨工业大学
character: The main campus features neoclassical-style architecture such as the three-story Administration Building with dormer windows, pillar reliefs, a front colonnade, and flanking lawns.

landmarks.name: 校部楼
landmarks.quote: 哈工大校部楼建于1929年，位于哈尔滨复华二道街1号，是哈工大最古老的建筑
landmarks.look: Three-story neoclassical building with semi-basement, dormer-windowed attic, pillar reliefs, and front colonnade.

landmarks.name: 土木楼
landmarks.quote: 1958年，哈工大的校部机关由土木楼搬楼，因而改名为“校部楼”。

landmarks.name: 草坪
landmarks.look: Flat green lawns flanking the front colonnade of the Administration Building.
